title: HBOCpred: An Ensemble Framework for Prioritisation of Germline Missense Variants in Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer.
snippet: HBOCpred was developed to support research prioritisation of unresolved germline missense variants in a defined 17-gene study panel. Four calibrated learners provide vote states (V0-V4) and a continuous modified adaptive classifier score (S).
